name: Tousaku Kyoushitsu
source:
A prestigious school has a long history of discrimination that's called tradition here.
Main character is an ordinary boy who wakes up without memory in the health room, and woman before him claims to be his slave. He tries to watch recorded videos to restore his memory, and it shows humiliation play. In time, a new form of love is born...

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/03/vn-of-month-august-2006-eve-new.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
一所名门学校有着悠久的歧视历史，而这里的人把它称作传统。
主人公是一名普通少年，醒来时失去了记忆，正躺在保健室里。面前的女人却声称自己是他的奴隶。为找回记忆，他开始观看过去录下的影像，画面里尽是凌辱游戏。随着时间流逝，一种全新的爱情逐渐诞生……

[译自 [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/03/vndb-of-month-august-2006-eve-new.html]vndbreview[/url]]
